native_mechanisms: A glint leaves the source jewel and crawls down each cord at a pace set by that cord's own length, so arrival time equals accumulated cord length (time-delayed wavefront propagation).
Each jewel's square is chalked at the instant of its first flare, and any later flare arriving via a longer cord is discarded without re-marking (label-setting, first settle is final, no updates).
Squares never reached by any flare are left blank and crossed out (unreachable vertices reported as infinite).
core_technique: Dial-style bucket/monotone-clock Dijkstra: a circular array of nb distance-quantized buckets (width delta from weight statistics) with doubly-linked vertex lists, a 64-bit-word bitmap ctz scan to skip empty buckets, decrease-key by bucket re-insertion, plus a pop-budget guard that falls back to lazy binary-heap Dijkstra.
